progress: Added measurement::Measurement typed Start/Value lifecycle, zero/add accumulator and to_f64 conversion. Suite::bench_measured registers a distinct batch-total metric and executes synchronous operations in BatchPolicy waves. A separate timer supplies wall observations and scheduling; custom numeric totals cannot replace elapsed time. Invalid finite/nonnegative conversion fails explicitly. Suite::bench_measured_with_input now prepares fresh inputs and deferred-output buffers before both clocks, excludes input destruction, and follows DropPolicy for outputs. Plain bench_measured shares this implementation via unit input. bench_measured_with_owned_input moves each fresh input exactly once using the same wave engine; consumed input destruction is included, while returned inputs follow output-drop policy. Ownership and lifecycle contracts distinguish this from borrowed inputs. bench_async_measured_with_input runs borrowing futures sequentially on a lazily initialized executor created before the custom wave timer. Future construction, polling and completion are included; outputs follow DropPolicy. Added bench_async_measured and bench_async_measured_with_owned_input using the shared async borrowed-input engine. Plain operations include output destruction; owned futures distinguish consumed input destruction from returned input deferred destruction. Added ValueFormatter with human/shared-scale, throughput and machine conversions. format_observations normalizes batches, uses one population-wide typical maximum, preserves missing rows, validates converted values/count/unit and leaves Run unchanged. Formatted rows serialize to JSON and render to Markdown/HTML tables. Suite::formatter registers presentation per case/metric; formatted_metrics checks the full metric contract on loaded runs. main emits human tables to console/HTML and human+machine formatted.json/BENCH_FORMATTED, retaining raw Run and comparison data. Loaded baselines are formatted with currently registered callbacks only when metric contracts agree. Suite main persists formatted snapshots in versioned provenance. Each snapshot hashes its metric contract and raw observations. report Markdown/HTML restores it without custom code; missing selected metrics are ignored and changed source values produce an explicit stale-formatting diagnostic. Snapshot writes validate before mutating the run.
